description: This file declares a generic class `Denque` representing a double-ended queue, providing methods for queue operations such as push, pop, shift, unshift, peek, remove, splice, and conversion to string or array. It also includes an interface `IDenqueOptions` for optional configuration.

classes.name: Denque
classes.description: A generic class implementing a double-ended queue with various queue manipulation methods.

methods.name: constructor(); constructor
methods.description: Constructs a Denque instance, optionally initialized with an array and configuration options.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an item to the back of the queue.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds an item to the front of the queue.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the item from the back of the queue.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the item from the front of the queue.

methods.name: peekBack
methods.description: Returns the item at the back of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: peekFront
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the queue without removing it.

methods.name: peekAt
methods.description: Returns the item at a specific index.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the item at a specific index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified number of items starting at the given index.

methods.name: removeOne
methods.description: Removes and returns a single item at the specified index.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Removes and optionally inserts items starting at the specified index.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the queue is empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all items from the queue.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the queue.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the queue.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array of the queue's items.
